Massage in Bellevue, Washington

Personalized care for relaxation and recovery

Fall Health Spa is located at 1445 130th Ave NE in Bellevue, WA. Our massage therapy sessions are shaped around your preferred pressure, areas of muscle tension and the way you want to feel afterward. Some guests visit for quiet stress relief, while others want focused attention after work, travel or physical activity.

Swedish massage in Bellevue uses flowing techniques and adjustable pressure for full-body relaxation. Guests who carry persistent tightness may prefer a deep tissue massage, which uses slower, more focused work. A couples massage lets two people unwind together while each session remains personalized.

Our Bellevue service menu also includes sports massage for active bodies and post-exercise recovery, foot reflexology for a focused treatment for tired feet, and Ashiatsu massage for guests who enjoy broad, deep pressure. For a distinctive synchronized experience, two therapists provide our four hands massage.

Not sure which service fits? Start with our complete massage service guide, compare current massage prices, or call (425) 454-7177. Before every appointment, you can discuss comfort, pressure and focus areas. Our goal is straightforward: provide a professional, welcoming massage experience in Bellevue without treating every guest or every day the same.
